subtests.name: A later Path attribute overrides an earlier one
A non-ASCII byte in the value is not a parse failure
A non-ASCII Path attribute followed by a valid one is not a parse failure
A non-ASCII byte in the winning Path attribute is a parse failure
A Path attribute with non-ASCII bytes appended does not match that path
A non-ASCII Path attribute does not fall back to the default path
A lone non-ASCII byte in the winning Path attribute is a parse failure
